messages:
mika: quick heads-up — opened a docs PR to clarify pricing tiers + quota header example. also added a note about how metering ties to billing. would love a pair of eyes on the dashboard panel naming and the python SDK snippet. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/742

sam: thanks! skimmed it — the pricing tier table looks good but we should be explicit about burst semantics (how burst counts towards quota vs throttling). can you add a tiny example showing burst spike handling? :thinking_face:

mika: yep will add. thinking a small example + expected token accounting sentence. also want to include the `X-Redwood-Quota` header example for customers that set tier metadata via client proxy.

laura: I can update the dashboard panel names — do you want the panels named by metric id or friendly name? e.g. `usage.requests_per_minute (prod)` vs `Prod requests / min`

mika: friendly names pls, matching Grafana consoles: `Prod - Requests / min`, `Prod - Token spend (USD)`, `Prod - 95th latency ms`. I'll add those strings to the doc, laura can you confirm exact panel slugs so the links work?

ajay: quick SDK snippet suggestion — include both header example and how to read quota info from response headers. small Python snippet:```python
from redwood import Redwood
client = Redwood(api_key=os.environ.get("REDWOOD_KEY"))
resp = client.requests.create(prompt="hello")
quota = resp.headers.get("X-Redwood-Quota")
print("quota header:", quota)
```

ajay: and a cURL for the proxy header:```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "X-Redwood-Quota: tier=pro;burst=500" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/requests
```

docs-bot: PR #742 updated: added burst example and grafana panel screenshots — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/742/files (CI: ✅)

mika: pushed a tiny clarification on billing: "burst tokens are metered and billed but may be rate-limited if sustained beyond burst window". also added an anchor for the old dashboard link and a redirect note. @laura once you confirm panel slugs i'll update the links. :pray:

laura: confirmed panel slugs and pushed one-line link fix. preview screenshot attached in PR. :white_check_mark:

sam: lgtm, will merge after smoke CI passes. thanks all for quick turnaround. :shipit:

mika: awesome — thanks everyone. merging in ~10m after CI green.

sam: CI green — merged. :tada:
